dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: I've still got lots of vacation time. That said, don't you think the combat postings assigned to you are a bit much?

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Eh, don't you worry about me. Once Turenna takes over from me as instructor, she'll bring in a new batch of skilled rookies. That should free both Marine and Roxane's schedules!

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Next time Tidalga is brewed, I'll be able to return to the village early.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: And remember, don't bring any weapons with you. You won't have anywhere to place them in your house!
